name: Jägerhof
beschreibung: The Jägerhof is situated in a quiet location surrounded by Alpine forests in the Tiroler Unterland. The traditional atmosphere of the inn is characterized by a paneled parlor and a tiled stove. Typical offerings include Tiroler Spezialitäten such as Gröstl and Kaiserschmarrn from the in-house kitchen. Guests can expect authentic hospitality and a regional drinks menu. The inn often serves as a stop for hikers and ski tourers. The rooms are functionally furnished but kept in a well-maintained rustic style. Overall, visitors can expect down-to-earth and uncomplicated hospitality.
